title: AutoRL: A Multi-Agent System towards Autonomous Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.17790v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) is one of the most promising paths toward an AI singularity for superintelligence. Achieving this vision requires AI systems to undertake the full training pipeline for iterative improvement. Reinforcement learning (RL) plays an essential role in this cycle to improve model capabilities and generalization, yet automating RL remains difficult due to unstable training dynamics and the need for sustained supervision. We introduce AutoRL, a multi-agent system for automating RL training, as a cornerstone for future RSI. Different from conducting research by end-to-end complete experiments, AutoRL monitors the evolving training state and integrates process-level supervision and research into an ongoing RL training, following the practical workflow of an RL researcher. translated_title: AutoRL：面向自主强化学习的多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）是通向超级智能AI奇点最有希望的路径之一。实现这一愿景需要AI系统能够承担完整的训练流程以进行迭代改进。强化学习（RL）在这一循环中扮演着至关重要的角色，用于提升模型能力和泛化能力，然而由于训练动态不稳定以及需要持续监督，实现强化学习的自动化仍然困难重重。我们提出了AutoRL——一个用于自动化强化学习训练的多智能体系统，作为未来递归自我改进的基石。与通过端到端完整实验开展研究的方式不同，AutoRL监控不断演变的训练状态，并将过程级的监督和研究融入正在进行的强化学习训练中，遵循强化学习研究人员的实际工作流程。具体而言，AutoRL由三个强化学习专属的智能体角色组成。感知器追踪训练动态、样本采集、评估和效率，并触发……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: AutoRL提出了一个由感知器等多个强化学习专属智能体角色组成的多智能体系统，通过持续监控演变的训练状态并将过程级监督与研究融入正在进行的RL训练，实现强化学习训练的自动化，为未来的递归自我改进（RSI）奠定基石。
en_tdlr: AutoRL is a multi-agent system that automates reinforcement learning training by monitoring evolving training states and integrating process-level supervision and research into ongoing RL training, serving as a cornerstone for future recursive self-improvement (RSI).
